name: Turkey
risk_context: Democratic backsliding under Erdogan with imprisonment of opposition leader Imamoglu sparking protests. NATO member with independent foreign policy. Kurdish insurgency (PKK) in southeast. Military operations in northern Syria/Iraq. Syrian refugee tensions. Economic volatility with high inflation. 2023 earthquake aftermath. Regional power broker in multiple conflicts.
